canonical_question: What specific boundary conditions were applied to the diffusion simulation to model the 'experimentally measured composition' at the surface?

question_variants.question: What specific boundary conditions were applied to the diffusion simulation to model the 'experimentally measured composition' at the surface?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The diffusion simulation boundary condition assigned the diffusion flux of each element at the surface as a function of the experimentally measured composition Cr 25 Fe 37.5 Ni 37.5.

answers.answer: The specific boundary condition applied was assigning the diffusion flux of each element at one end as a function of the experimentally measured composition Cr 25 Fe 37.5 Ni 37.5 at the surface.
answers.mechanism: Mn diffusion out of alloy reduces the stability of the BCC phase
evidence_spans: In order to confirm the above findings, CALPHAD calculations were performed to determine all the equilibrium phases for the Cr 18 Mn 27 Fe 27.5 Ni 27.5 alloy.
At 700 °C, the alloy is expected to contain both FCC and BCC phases.
The BCC phase is approximately 4% in phase fraction and is rich in Cr and low in Ni with nominal composition of Cr 67 Fe 13 Mn 18.5 Ni 1.5 .
